title: Spectral amplification for ground-state energy estimation of electronic structure in first quantization
summary: We demonstrate an asymptotic gate complexity improvement in first-quantized ground-state energy estimation of electronic structure Hamiltonians in a plane wave basis by employing the sum-of-squares spectral gap amplification protocol. The improvement relies on identifying a sum-of-squares representation of the Hamiltonian which provides a lower bound certificate and low cost block encoding that leads to a provably lower quantum phase estimation gate cost.
